patterns.name: Explicit package contract
patterns.description: Packages contribute routes, assets, navigation, and browser entries through one shared host contract.

patterns.name: Manifest allowlist
patterns.description: Only packages explicitly selected by repository configuration are loaded.

patterns.name: Package-safe repository read
patterns.description: Package handlers resolve repository paths through HostContext before reading files.

patterns.name: Agent-capable package
patterns.description: Packages with LLM agents expose SSE streaming, credential management, and a prompt submission route following the same contract pattern.

patterns.name: Dual-scope package loading
patterns.description: Team packages load from checked-in config first; member packages load from an external live checkout and lose conflicts.
